zeroAndLegality.opponentEmpty: Inferred from general no-effect Supporter rule: cannot play this exact Emma because there are no faces to reveal and no count-based draw can happen. zeroAndLegality.ownDeckEmptyOpponentNonempty: Inferred legal because the opponent-hand reveal remains meaningful. Draw0, no immediate deck-out, complete Supporter use and Buddy Attack qualification. First subsequent own-turn draw remains the ordinary deck-out boundary.
zeroAndLegality.shortDeck: Draw all available cards up to captured Pokemon count, no immediate loss or shuffle; bind requested count separately from actual drawn count if both are modeled.
zeroAndLegality.directFaqLimit: No direct Emma FAQ for empty opponent hand, zero Pokemon, empty own deck or short deck was found. These are printed-text/general-rule inferences consistent with existing reveal/draw legality paths; tests must be labeled accordingly.
